summary_en: Sekisui Jushi will tender 380,000 shares of Nihon Kougyo (an associate company) to a ToSTNeT-3 self-buyback, representing approximately 55.1% of its 690,000-share holding. Settlement is expected in fiscal 2027, with the sale expected to result in Nihon Kougyo ceasing to be an associate company.
title_en: Notice of Subscription to Self-Share Repurchase by Affiliate Company through Off-Exchange Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 4, 2026, Sekisui Jushi announced its decision to tender 380,000 shares of Nihon Kougyo—an associate company accounted for under the equity method—to a self-share repurchase being conducted by Nihon Kougyo through an off-exchange transaction (ToSTNeT-3). This represents 55.1% of Sekisui Jushi's total holding of 690,000 shares in Nihon Kougyo. The decision was approved by the board of directors on October 29, 2026, and was formalized following confirmation of the repurchase terms announced by Nihon Kougyo. If all tendered shares are sold, Nihon Kougyo will no longer qualify as an associate company of Sekisui Jushi.

The company stated that the decision reflects its commitment to capital-cost-aware management and optimization of asset composition. Both companies have agreed to clarify the independence of their respective operations while maintaining a collaborative business partnership based on individual economic rationale. The sale of these shares is intended to enhance capital efficiency and facilitate more efficient allocation of management resources.

If the tender is fully settled, Sekisui Jushi expects to record a loss on the sale of affiliate shares in the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, but anticipates the financial impact to consolidated earnings will be immaterial.
